source: ISO 2338 type B (h8) steel dowel pin, 3 mm dia (3 mm h8: 0 to -0.014); length comes from the request (ISO 2338 stock 6-30 mm). Pin fit holes are an FDM convention (assumed, +/-0.05 mm): a printed hole prints undersize, so the press-fit hole is the nominal size and the clearance hole 0.2 mm larger.
frame: mech: origin at the centre of the pin's base end, axis +Z

chamfer.source: ISO 2338 type B: approx. end chamfer (not modelled in the solid)

press_fit_hole.source: assumed FDM convention: nominal hole prints tight on a h8 pin

clearance_hole.source: assumed FDM convention: sliding location hole, +0.2 mm

min_engagement.source: assumed convention: engagement of at least 1.5 x diameter in the receiving part

gate_params.source: sample size used only by the load-time validation gate; never a design value

self_checks.name: press-fit hole not above the pin
